reason: A dsh plugin that waits for the local web interface to become ready, prints its URL, and automatically opens it in the user’s default browser across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh web 界面就绪后打印本地访问链接，并自动使用系统默认浏览器打开。
summaries.en: Prints the local dsh web interface URL and opens it automatically in the system default browser when ready.

capabilities: Reads the local dsh web server port
Launches the system default browser through platform-specific commands
Supports disabling automatic browser opening via configuration or environment variable
